# Aditya Mahakali

> Applied AI Architect building production AI systems: RAG, agentic pipelines, and enterprise ML/GenAI. Open to both full-time roles and consulting engagements.

Currently AI Architect at Aintropy (aintropy.ai), building an agentic, video-first cognitive pipeline. Previously AI/ML Engineer at IBM (Aug 2023-Apr 2026), where he delivered 12+ enterprise GenAI systems including a conversational RAG banking assistant (85% first-call resolution), RAG APIs over 100k+ documents, secure NL2SQL microservices, and Neo4j knowledge-graph RAG. Co-authored the SEARCHD retrieval-evaluation paper (IEEE, 2024).
